Title: Name changes: Azure Batch Rendering V-Ray

Body.Content:
Azure Batch Rendering accelerates large-scale rendering jobs by letting artists, engineers, and designers submit rendering jobs via client apps (like Maya and 3ds Max) or via our SDK.

Effective January 1, 2018, the billing meter name for the Chaos Group V-Ray software will change from “VRay” to “V-Ray” to reflect the correct name of the software. Pricing won’t be affected, but you might need to modify billing routines that rely on meter names. Learn more about Batch Rendering on the overview and pricing webpages.
